messages:
sophie_sales: Quick pass to CS — signed today: Boreal Health (pilot -> dedicated). Key asks flagged in contract: VPC peering, SSO (SAML), and a 30-day dedicated trial. Customer wants go-live in 3 weeks which is tight. Renewal/expansion conversation should start early :thinking_face:

omar_csm: Thanks Sophie — adding context: org size ~120 devs, initial expected qps low (~10 rps) but they plan to scale. Main risk: security team requires cert + internal audit before prod. Renewal signal: finance wants usage-based billing capped after trial.

sophie_sales: FYI customer contact is Lucy (cc'ed). She said infra can unblock SSO quickly if we provide IdP metadata and a test SP. Also asked for a short runbook for the trial.

omar_csm: Action items for CS: 1) schedule kickoff with Lucy & infra, 2) share onboarding checklist + success metrics (reduce avg latency < 400ms for Gen API). I can own the playbook and renewal touchpoints.

tara_onboard_pm: I'll take kickoff scheduling. Proposed slots: Tue 10am or Wed 3pm PST. I need: IdP metadata file, env whitelist for VPC peering, and list of endpoints they plan to hit.

kevin_eng_support: Noted. I'll open infra ticket for VPC peering (internal ref: PEER-7842) and request network team for route table review. For the SAML setup, can you ask customer to upload metadata to this secure form: https://redwood-internal/onboard/forms/saml-upload ? Also need a sample audit log retention policy — do they require >1yr?

lucy_boreal: Wed 3pm PST works. We can share IdP metadata today. Audit retention: health compliance needs 2 years retention, but we can start with 6 months for pilot if needed.

omar_csm: Good to know on retention. I'll draft a one-page pilot runbook and share before the call. Also: please confirm whether they want dedicated GPU tier or dedicated CPU (billing differences). Sophie — any nuance in the contract?

sophie_sales: Contract specifies "reserved capacity — dedicated GPU pool if needed" but initial trial not guaranteed GPU. We promised a 30-day reserved capacity window if they opt in within trial. Finance asked for a usage cap and auto-notify before cap hit.

kevin_eng_support: For the trial, recommend starting on dedicated CPU with autoscale to GPU if latency targets not met. I'll prepare a recommended config snippet for the ops team:

```yaml
deployment:
  mode: dedicated_cpu
  autoscale:
    metrics: [latency, token_throttle]
    scale_to: gpu_if_latency_above: 450ms
    max_gpus: 2
```

kevin_eng_support: Also: please get us a list of sample prompt patterns and expected token lengths — helps tune batching and caching.

omar_csm: I'll collect prompt examples from Lucy and attach them to the kickoff calendar invite.
lucy_boreal: Will send sample prompts + IdP metadata before EOD. Also: interested in a short training session for our product team during week 2 of trial.

tara_onboard_pm: Noted — I'll put a 30-minute enablement slot in week 2 and include docs + quick eval checklist.

omar_csm: Summary of owners: Sophie (sales) — closed contract + billing constraints; Omar (CS) — account lead + renewal plan; Tara (onboard PM) — kickoff & enablement; Kevin (support/eng) — infra & config; Lucy (customer) — provides metadata & prompts. Next steps: Sophie to share contract excerpt in thread; Lucy to upload metadata; Tara to send invite for Wed 3pm PST. I'll share pilot runbook draft by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sophie_sales: Posted contract excerpt in thread — see attachment in the CRM link: https://crm.redwood/boreal/contract/174332.

omar_csm: Thanks — I'll create a renewal cadence doc and set reminders at day 15 and day 25 of trial. Leaving this thread open for any prep notes.
